mechanism: Primidone is a potent inducer of CYP3A4 and other metabolic enzymes, which may theoretically enhance vedolizumab metabolism and reduce its therapeutic efficacy, though vedolizumab undergoes minimal hepatic metabolism.
action: Monitor clinical response to vedolizumab; vedolizumab's mechanism as a selective integrin antagonist is largely independent of hepatic metabolism, so dose adjustment is unlikely necessary, but therapeutic drug monitoring may be warranted if disease control deteriorates.
